acceptance.given: A proposed success evaluation has identity and execution facts available for verification.

oracle.expected: The evaluation permits success only when every identity and execution fact is current, present, unambiguous, and verifiable; otherwise it produces an unsuccessful terminal result.
forbidden: A success outcome is reported while identity or execution facts remain unknown, missing, stale, ambiguous, or unverifiable.
oracle.observable: The replay result's identity and execution-fact validation and terminal category.

acceptance.then: Success is blocked for any ambiguous identity or execution fact.
acceptance.when: The Toolchain evaluates whether to emit a success terminal category for a replay result.

failure_intents.selector_intent: Exercise a replay result with an ambiguous or unverifiable bound identity/execution fact and observe rejection of success.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Make replay success contingent on canonical verification that all bound identity and execution facts are present, current, unambiguous, and verifiable.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: No persisted state or schema migration; removing the gate restores prior replay evaluation behavior.

slice_hint.state_transition: An evaluation with ambiguous identity or execution facts transitions to an unsuccessful terminal category rather than success.
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: A success terminal category exists only after all identity and execution facts are verified unambiguous; ambiguous facts reject success.

acceptance.given: The three specified evaluation-seed records are available for Toolchain validation.

oracle.expected: Each of the three named seed records occurs exactly once and exposes provenance information.
forbidden: 任一指定评估种子缺少来源信息
oracle.observable: The validated evaluation-seed records and their provenance fields.

acceptance.then: The seed set is accepted only when provenance is readable for every specified seed.
acceptance.when: The Toolchain validates the three named evaluation seeds.

failure_intents.selector_intent: Remove provenance from one specified seed while retaining the other seed fields, then observe rejection.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Validate the three named evaluation-seed records as unique records with readable provenance before accepting the seed set.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: No persisted state or schema migration; rollback removes only seed-provenance validation behavior.

slice_hint.state_transition: A seed set with complete provenance remains eligible for further validation; a seed set with an absent provenance field is rejected.
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: All three specified seed identities occur exactly once and each exposes provenance; otherwise the seed validation fails.

acceptance.given: An aggregate execution is started with configured bounded process and output controls.

oracle.expected: The aggregate reaches one deterministic terminal category; time or output budget exhaustion is unsuccessful.
forbidden: The aggregate remains without a terminal state.
Budget exhaustion is treated as success or reduces required coverage.
oracle.observable: The aggregate terminal category after bounded execution and its deterministic classification.

acceptance.then: The aggregate terminates deterministically, and exhaustion is unsuccessful.
acceptance.when: Aggregate execution terminates or reaches its time/output budget.

failure_intents.selector_intent: Run a bounded aggregate whose controlled process exceeds its configured time or output budget and observe an unsuccessful deterministic terminal category.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Classify every aggregate completion deterministically under bounded time and output; classify budget exhaustion as unsuccessful without reducing coverage.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: No persisted state or schema migration; rollback restores the former aggregate-process handling.

slice_hint.state_transition: An executing aggregate transitions exactly once to a deterministic terminal category; exhausted budgets transition to an unsuccessful category.
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: Every aggregate has a deterministic terminal category, and any time/output budget exhaustion is unsuccessful.

acceptance.given: A fresh checkout has the pinned result-determining inputs and the original Exact Cover binding available for reconstruction.

oracle.expected: Reconstruction from the pinned inputs produces the original Exact Cover and terminal semantic verdict; any unexplained bound-input difference fails closed.
forbidden: 重建后的 Exact Cover 与固定输入对应的原始覆盖结果不一致
覆盖关系缺失、变化或无法由 pinned inputs 重建却仍宣称成功
oracle.observable: The Exact Cover validator's comparison of the reconstructed cover and terminal semantic verdict against the original pinned binding.

acceptance.then: The reconstructed Exact Cover equals the original result, or the reconstruction fails closed.
acceptance.when: An independent operator reconstructs the result from a fresh checkout using all pinned inputs.

failure_intents.selector_intent: Alter one pinned result-determining input or the reconstructed cover relation in a fresh-checkout replay and observe closed failure rather than success.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Rebuild the original Exact Cover from a fresh checkout and all pinned result-determining inputs, compare it with the original bound cover, and fail closed on any mismatch or unexplained input drift.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: No persisted state or schema migration; rollback restores prior conformance validation behavior.

slice_hint.state_transition: A fresh-checkout reconstruction transitions to reproduced only when the rebuilt Exact Cover and terminal verdict match the original pinned binding; otherwise it transitions to failure.
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: Fresh-checkout reconstruction using all pinned inputs reproduces the original Exact Cover and terminal semantic verdict; mismatched or unreconstructable coverage cannot succeed.
